Connect to your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Notes sent to an external AI provider leave your GlassKeep instance. To keep data local, use a local endpoint such as Ollama, Open WebUI, or LiteLLM on your network.

GlassKeep appends /chat/completions itself, so leave that off. Examples: http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama), https://your-openwebui.example/api (Open WebUI), https://api.openai.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
Must match a model name available on the provider (e.g. llama3.1:8b, qwen2.5:7b, gpt-4o-mini).

So your reminders fire on time even when the app is fully closed, allow GlassKeep to ignore battery optimization. Without it, Android may delay or block reminders in the background. It\'s optional — you can decline, and reminders will still work most of the time.
